Former Treasury Secretary Larry Summers called President Donald Trump's accusation without providing evidence that the top Bureau of Labor Statistics official manipulated jobs report numbers "a preposterous charge" on Sunday.

Speaking with "This Week" anchor George Stephanopoulos, Summers said that one official would not be able to change the numbers. "These numbers are put together by teams of literally hundreds of people following detailed procedures that are in manuals.
There's no conceivable way that the head of the BLS could have manipulated this number," Summers said.
Summers. "Larry Summers says Trump's accusations of manipulated jobs numbers are ‘preposterous’." _This Week, American Broadcasting Corporation_, August 3, 2025.
